changes.old: Close shot on a neighborhood street in 1908, an anonymous field worker studies an unmarked city map, gentle window light
changes.new: Medium close shot on a bare San Francisco lot in August 1908, one elderly female field visitor with silver hair tied back and a deeply lined side profile in a dark high-collared wool coat approaches a single small low wooden relief cottage while holding a closed unlettered notebook at her side; the cottage broad-plank wall and low roof fill the background, bare earth underfoot, soft overcast daylight, full-bleed frame

changes.old: Wide shot at a public square in 1907, an anonymous adult rests a hand on a cottage doorway, muted afternoon light
changes.new: Medium shot across a bare San Francisco public square in 1907, one tall grey-haired older resident with a deeply lined face in a plain dark high-collared wool coat walks between two small low wooden relief cottages carrying a folded wool blanket; plain plank walls and shallow roofs stand against open pale sky, unpaved earth in foreground, full-bleed frame
